This flowers is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in tall grasslands, and is best known in north-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is prepared as a paste.

Level 4 circulatory poison, chiefly known in Saralainn. Depending on the severity of the failed Resistance Roll, it causes temporary or lasting blindness, coma, or death.
